name: Ghost
description: Ghost describes itself as "a powerful app for professional publishers to create, share, and grow a business around their content" — an open-source blogging and newsletter platform with built-in membership and subscription tools.
best_for: Ghost positions itself for creators (YouTubers, bloggers, podcasters, musicians), publishers/journalists, businesses running content marketing, and developers.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Billed yearly. 1 staff seat, capped at 1,000 members, only simple design settings (no custom themes).

tiers.name: Publisher
tiers.notes: Billed yearly. 3 staff seats, same 1,000-member cap as Starter, adds custom themes and paid subscriptions.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Billed yearly. 15 staff seats, 10,000-member cap, priority support, and a 99.9% uptime SLA.

tiers.name: Custom
tiers.notes: Contact Ghost directly for unlimited members/staff and advanced configuration.

cons: No permanent free tier of the managed product -- Ghost(Pro) is trial-only for 14 days, then paywalled; the only forever-free option is fully self-hosting the open-source software yourself.
Starter and Publisher share the same 1,000-member ceiling despite the price gap, and hitting the member cap blocks new signups and publishing until you upgrade.

Bulk newsletter sending is not native to the platform -- it depends on a third-party Mailgun integration, and a newly registered Mailgun account is capped at 100 emails/hour, which self-hosters hit directly since Ghost(Pro) is the only tier where this is pre-configured.
features: Rich publishing editor (galleries, video, audio, embeds)
Native email newsletter delivery with segmentation

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.description: An open-source publishing platform with block editing, themes, and plugins.
alternatives.best_for: Creators and businesses wanting a self-hosted, highly extensible publishing platform.

alternatives.name: Squarespace
alternatives.description: A website builder combining design templates with integrated business/marketing tools.
alternatives.best_for: Creatives and small businesses wanting an all-in-one hosted site.
